title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics runbook helpers and SLO toolkit integration
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Adds helpers that link incident-bot automated diagnostics to runbooks and enrich SLO context for on-call workflows. Backwards-compatible; opt-in via config.
description:
Motivation: On recent incidents the oncall flow lacked contextual links between automated diagnostics produced by incident-bot and runbook steps maintained in the SLO toolkit. Engineers spent time locating the right runbook and correlating SLO context. This change introduces a set of helpers that: 1) attach ranked runbook links to autodiagnostics suggestions, 2) annotate runbook links with SLO context (owner, relevant metrics, recent regression flags), and 3) expose a lightweight SDK function for runbook resolution that other tools (pager handlers, oncall summaries) can call.

Summary of changes: Adds runbook resolver and linker in incident-bot, SLO context enrichment utilities in slo-toolkit, a small REST API endpoint for runbook lookups (internal-only), template changes to oncall messages to include compact runbook hints, and end-to-end tests and documentation. The helpers are behind a feature flag (oncall.autodiag.runbook_linking) and default to off for existing customers.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement runbook resolver and ranking heuristics
- [x] Integrate SLO metadata enrichment (owner, alerting thresholds, recent regressions)
- [x] Add internal REST endpoint and SDK wrapper
- [x] Add unit and integration tests
- [x] Update docs and runbook templates
- [x] Feature-flag rollout and migration notes

Testing & rollout: Unit tests added for resolver heuristics and SLO enrichment. Integration test simulates an oncall autodiagnostic and validates the runbook links are attached and render correctly in Slack messages. CI had one flaky integration test that failed once and was retriggered; final CI is green. Rollout will be controlled via the feature flag: enable in staging, run canary for two weeks, then enable org-default for opted-in customers. Rollback is a config toggle to disable linking immediately.

Impact: Improves mean time to resolution by surfacing runbook actions directly in autodiagnostics; low risk since behind a flag and read-only to runbook metadata. No data migration required.
